description: Grasping-moment frame annotations for successful HRDexDB episodes used by contact heatmap generation.
frame_field: grasp_frame is the integer frame number encoded by the source annotation; for paired annotations it is parsed from grasp/debug_masks/refined_frame_XXXXXX.png.

source_notes.allegro_v5: Source has object -> episode -> {frame, paired_human_episode} records and no explicit failure/status field; all records are included as annotated successful episodes.
source_notes.human_and_inspire_f1: Only records with status == success are included. Failed paired-review records are excluded.
